title: Accept a moved base in the ship verifier
body:
krn ship leases the current main as the base and passes it to the repository verifier, while GitHub keeps a pull request's base SHA at the main commit of its last push. `scripts/pr-preflight.mjs` requires the two to be equal, so every reviewed Product pull request is refused as soon as main moves (2026-10-27: #121 refused after #122 merged). The merge-path decision already states the review base must be an ancestor of the merge base.
Acceptance: preflight passes when the PR base SHA equals the requested base or is its ancestor, and refuses when it is not in the requested base history; `test/pr-preflight.test.ts` covers both and fails without the change.
